common_protocol.judge_protocol: same terminal-success protocol as paired BrowserCode comparison

primary_analysis: New extension200 tasks; all-three common-valid comparisons plus fixed-grid overall and valid-only outcomes. Combined300 reuses outcome-observed Luna100 and is secondary.
old_sol61_reference: Historical only; no GPT-6.1 outcome substitutes for the new GPT-6 Sol single-high arm.

metrics.cost: Every proposal and selector with actual native usage; judge separate. Unknown usage keeps its full budget reservation.
metrics.tokens: Input, cached-input/cache-write, output and reported reasoning; reasoning is included in output and is not added twice.
metrics.task_latency: Agent wall time; excludes setup, final capture and judge. Summed API durations include parallel calls and are not task wall time.

browser_steps.model_decisions: Completed native model decisions, including observations and completion.
browser_steps.browser_code_batches_attempted: Native executor step files excluding the initial controller viewport setup.
browser_steps.native_browsercode_cdp_attempts: CDP calls recorded by the native bridge, including setup and observation calls; not equivalent to model decisions.

metrics.retained_records: Existing outcomes stay immutable; missing metadata will be derived from their original native receipts into separate analysis artifacts.
